description: Every error response is {"error": {"code", "message", "retry_after_seconds"?, "attempts_left"?}}. Clients branch on code; message is for logs and fallbacks. retry_after_seconds is also sent as the Retry-After header.

bad_request.meaning: The request body or parameters are malformed.

bad_thumbnail.meaning: A thumbnail must be a JPEG of at most 1024×1024 pixels.

length_required.meaning: tus: the file size must be known when an upload starts.

pin_format.meaning: The input can't be a PIN at all. Doesn't count as a wrong try.

login_wrong.meaning: Wrong username or password. attempts_left says how many tries remain before a pause.

pin_ended.meaning: The code belonged to a PIN that has ended. Counts as a wrong try.

pin_wrong.meaning: No live PIN with this code. attempts_left says how many tries remain before a pause.

session_ended.meaning: The PIN session's PIN ended or expired, or the session was signed out. Unlock again; unfinished uploads move to the new session.

signed_out.meaning: This phone's or browser's key was revoked or its account deleted, a browser went unused for 400 days, or a browser that signed in at home was used from elsewhere. Sign in again. A browser's answer also deletes its cookie.

unauthorized.meaning: No valid PIN session or device token.

cross_origin.meaning: A browser request that changes something didn't come from Share's own pages: another site, or a request carrying the website's cookie but saying neither Origin nor Sec-Fetch-Site.

forbidden.meaning: Not allowed, e.g. deleting a finished upload over tus, or sending a thumbnail more than a day after the upload.

https_required.meaning: Plain http from outside a home network. Use the public address, which is https.

password_wrong.meaning: The current password is wrong. attempts_left says how many tries remain before a pause.

too_many_uploads.meaning: tus: too many unfinished uploads for this session; let some finish.

invite_unknown.meaning: No such invite; the link is wrong or incomplete.

not_found.meaning: No such thing, or it belongs to someone else.

last_admin.meaning: The change would leave nobody who can manage the server.

offset_mismatch.meaning: tus: the upload is at a different offset; HEAD and continue from there.

pin_taken.meaning: A PIN had this code before; codes are never used twice. Pick another one.

invite_revoked.meaning: The invite was withdrawn, or the person it was for was removed.

invite_used.meaning: The invite was used already; invites work once.

no_space.meaning: tus: the server's drive has no room for this file.

too_large.meaning: The file (tus) or the thumbnail (512 KiB) is larger than the server accepts.

unsupported_media_type.meaning: The body has the wrong Content-Type: application/json for JSON endpoints, image/jpeg for thumbnails. A browser's POST to the API must be JSON even without a body: send {}.

invite_locked.meaning: Too many unknown invites from this address; wait retry_after_seconds.

login_locked.meaning: Too many wrong passwords, at sign-in or as the current one when changing it; wait retry_after_seconds.

pin_locked.meaning: Too many wrong PINs; wait retry_after_seconds.

finalize_failed.meaning: tus: all bytes arrived but the file couldn't be stored yet; the client retries with HEAD.

busy.meaning: Too many uploads (tus) or ZIP downloads running at once; retry after the Retry-After header.
